The Pharmacy Automation Lead serves as a technical leader with advanced knowledge of pharmacy technology and recognized expertise in pharmacy operations. The role independently analyzes and resolves complex or unique technology and workflow issues, often requiring solutions where established processes or precedents may not exist.

In collaboration with Pharmacy Managers and Supervisors, the Pharmacy Automation Lead supports the oversight, implementation, optimization, maintenance, and advancement of pharmacy automation technologies and associated processes. Systems may include, but are not limited to automated dispensing systems (e.g. Pyxis, Omnicell), Boxpicker, unit-dose packaging systems, Codonics, RFID scanning technology, IV compounding technologies and other related pharmacy automation systems. The role ensures systems remain operational, reliable, and optimized to support safe and efficient pharmacy services, and coordinates with vendors and internal partners as needed for troubleshooting, repair, maintenance, upgrades, and system enhancements. The role may also lead pharmacy technology initiatives and support the development of related strategies, workflows, policies, and processes.
